o1: Enables guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity and small GTPase binding activity. Involved in Rho protein signal transduction; embryonic body morphogenesis; cytokinesis; and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Is located in axon and cell body. Is expressed in embryo; lateral epidermal cells; nervous system; pharyngeal cell; seam cell; and tail. Is part of the embryonic elongation pathway. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease recessive intermediate C and autosomal recessive distal hereditary motor neuronopathy 4. Orthologous to several human genes including PLEKHG5 (pleckstrin homology and RhoGEF domain containing G5).
